children: LifeStance Health Group entered an underwriting agreement for an underwritten offering of 22,250,000 shares and repurchased 2,000,000 of those shares from the underwriter.
Underwriting agreement with Barclays for an offering of 22,250,000 common shares filed under Form S-3.
Company agreed to buy 2,000,000 shares from the underwriter at the price paid to selling stockholders; no underwriter compensation on repurchased shares.
All 22,250,000 shares were sold by selling stockholders; LifeStance received no proceeds from the offering.
Offering closed on September 11, 2026; legal opinion from Ropes & Gray filed as Exhibit 5.1.
